ITEM 1 | Golden-brown crisp-edged piece with a browned, slightly glossy top surface and pale cream underside, roughly 9 cm by 7 cm and 2 cm thick, sitting at the upper-left of the food cluster on the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Shredded, stringy pale-brown meat with darker browned edges and some light fibrous strands, moist-looking and holding loose clumps, roughly 9 cm by 6 cm and 2.5 cm high, sitting beneath and next to the browned piece on the left side of the plate | 140
ITEM 3 | Pale whitish-cream soft strands with a slight sheen, partially tucked among the shredded meat, roughly 4 cm long and 1 cm wide | 15
ITEM 4 | Mixed fresh salad greens with dark green leaves, some pale green and ribbed stems, thin pale slivers, and a few red-purple stems, loosely piled, dry-looking with no visible dressing sheen, covering roughly 10 cm by 11 cm and about 3 cm high on the right side of the plate | 70
ITEM 5 | A few small loose green herb or leaf fragments scattered at the top edge of the browned piece and along its left edge, each under 2 cm | 3
